target_customer: Consumers with credit card points who want cheaper flights
problem: Redeeming points is complex. Pointhound searches many airlines and transfer partners and explains how to book.
business_model: Credit card affiliate fees, Premium subscription and paid concierge booking
product_category: Travel points and award flight search

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating award availability across airline programs is scraping and partner integration work with moderate difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Search tools are copyable, though affiliate relationships and an audience add some advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. Rivals such as Point.me, Seats.aero and Roame exist per undated comparison articles.

market_need_then: Points redemption is widely seen as confusing, though no dated 2023 source was gathered here.

identity.logo: Scout, a character used as the site logo
identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat, conversational and reassuring, aimed at beginners

brand_strength.rationale: A distinct name, mascot and friendly voice appear on its own site, and a design brand co-founder is listed, but no independent press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Pointhound is an active S23 company run by repeat founders from Feather that earns affiliate and subscription revenue. A 2026 report summarized by RuntimeWire says four staff served 750,000 users in 2025, but funding and revenue are not disclosed, so its trajectory cannot be judged.
notes: Funding only on aggregators: VCBacked and Persana say $500K pre-seed in 2023, CB Insights says $1.5M over 3 rounds. Unverified, not recorded as rounds. Competitor sources undated, so the list is empty. Scout is named in the page assets, not described. The 750,000 users figure is a secondary summary of a WSJ report.
